text:
elaine: Quick sync — NimbusCloud private offer. Need final decision on commit tiers, discount ladder, renewal mechanics, and how/when to coordinate the SI joint announcement. Can we lock something by EOD Friday?

sam: Proposed tiers: $50k, $200k, $1M annual commit. Discounts: 10% / 15% / 25%. Add a one-time onboarding credit (equivalent to 5% of first-year commit) for the mid+ tiers. Thoughts?

juan: SI side: we'll need an enablement fund + a documented SOW template. Recommend co-sell credit (10% of Redwood ARR from the deal) for first 12 months. Also want to align on announcement timing — suggest announce 2 weeks after SI technical go-live so we can show integration screenshots.

maria: Renewal mechanics: prefer a "staircase" approach — if usage grows >=20% YoY, auto-increase next-year commit by that growth band and increase discount by +2pts. Also require quarterly true-ups with a 30-day invoice window. Renewal notice window: 60 days.

elaine: Good. Two quick asks: (1) Marketplace listing lead time — how long to get private-offer SKU live on cloud marketplaces? (2) SKU/entitlement naming convention so SI can map billing in their ops.

sam: Marketplace lead time: ~3–4 weeks for curated private offers on major clouds if we have contract + pricing matrix ready. For SKU naming, use: `rwd_market_nimbus_<tier>_commit_v1`. Example: `rwd_market_nimbus_tier2_commit_v1`. Keep stable for renewals.

platform-bizdev-bot: Created project board: https://rwd.internal/boards/PRT-398 (private-offer / SI enablement). Assigned elaine, sam, juan, maria.

juan: Hardware partner note: Nimbus may qualify for a HW-credit kicker — partner wants to add 10% additional credit if customer buys partner HW bundle. We should carve this into the offer as an optional add-on, first-year only.

maria: Margin flag — HW kicker will eat into unit economics. Acceptable only if limited to year 1 and capped at $100k per account. Also add a clause: HW credits don't count toward Redwood commit thresholds (to prevent gaming).

sam: Agree with caps. Suggest we run a canary private offer to 3 pilot customers for 6–8 weeks to validate billing flows + SI enablement. Start window: target Nov 1 for pilot. After successful pilot, open full private offer on marketplaces.

legal-jordan: Need to add audit & reporting clause (monthly consumption reports), a 30-day remediation period for underpayment, and a renewal opt-out window. Also flag cross-charge handling when HW credits are applied. I'll draft redlines by Thursday.

elaine: Action items: (1) sam to publish formal pricing matrix + SKU list (due Wed). (2) juan to draft SI SOW and co-sell credit language (due Thu). (3) legal-jordan to provide contract redlines (Thu). (4) maria to run margin sensitivity and cap recommendation (Wed). (5) I'll coordinate announcement schedule with SI for post-pilot (target Nov 15). Everyone ok? :thumbsup:

sam: 👍 will do pricing matrix.

juan: 👍 SOW draft incoming. I'll add readiness checklist for SI enablement (training, runbooks, demo kit).

maria: 👍 running numbers, will send worst/likely/best-case.

elaine: Great — if no objections, I'll lock timeline and tell Nimbus bizdev to expect private-offer onboarding checklist by Friday.

sam: No objections from me — :shipit:

legal-jordan: On it.

elaine: Thanks all — keeping the pilot small will make the announcement cleaner.
